newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: EMS share buy-back fully taken up.
newsitem.headline: EMS share buy-back fully taken up.

text.p: Swiss chemicals group EMS-Chemie Holding AG said its offer from May 9/10 to buy back a maximum 14,140 bearer shares had been fully taken up.
In a statement from EMS the company said a total of 14,140 bearer shares had been offered to the company.
EMS had offered to buy back the shares on May 6 at a price of 6,100 francs per share.
Together with a first share buy-back from March 27, EMS has bought back a total of 54,140 bearer shares in order to reduce its share capital.
The March share buy-back was instead of a dividend payment.
Assuming approval by shareholders on August 23, EMS's share capital will be reduced by 2.7 million Swiss francs to 27.29 million.
The capital will comprise 400,000 bearer shares, each with a nominal value of 50 francs, and 729,300 registered shares, each with a value of 10 francs, EMS said.
